newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Headlines - Feb 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Monday. Reuters had not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- MING PAO -- Confidence in the political and economic future has improved in Hong Kong to levels seen before the Beijing military crackdown of June 1989, a poll commissioned by the newspaper showed.

-- APPLE DAILY -- Almost 60 percent of respondents said their confidence in post-1997 civil liberties was undermined by China's plans to repeal key sections of Hong Kong's civil liberties laws, a poll revealed.
-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC TIMES -- Hong Kong will benefit from the U.S.-China textile trade agreement

-- The Hong Kong government will conduct a comprehensive review of Hong Kong's infrastructure needs, including energy supplies, port facilities and telecommunications, with a view to maintaining the territory's competitive edge.
-- WEN WEI PO -- Taiwan's chief delegate to recent cross-strait shipping talks with China, Lin Hsing-shan, said he expected direct sailings would begin by the end of March.
-- HONG KONG COMMERCIAL DAILY -- China's former Minister of National Defence, Qin Jiwei, a close associate of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, died in Beijing at the age of 82.
